key_insight: MedDDC-Eval separates evidence collection from final diagnosis generation, making it easier to measure how well a medical consultation agent asks useful questions and gathers diagnostic history.
clinical_relevance: This could improve evaluation and training of AI triage/consultation tools, especially where the quality of patient questioning matters as much as the final answer.
method: Uses a diagnosis-decoupled testbed that evaluates elicited history instead of end-to-end diagnosis alone.
Holds history-to-diagnosis mapping constant with a shared frozen reader to isolate policy quality.
Applies GRPO-based post-training on multi-turn rollouts using diagnosis-result and trajectory feedback.
evidence_signal: Across held-out Record and Dialogue splits, the framework showed that changing only the diagnostic reader shifted diagnosis F1 by 2.2–19.0 points and reversed 18%–36% of pairwise policy orderings.
watch_item: Results depend on a frozen shared reader and automated semantic matching, so real-world clinical validity may differ from benchmark performance.
paper_title: MedDDC-Eval: Diagnosis-Decoupled Evaluation of Multi-Turn Medical Consultation Agents
